options.text: Cup Q, because 61 °C is the higher reading.
Cup P, because a lower reading means hotter tea.
Cup P, because it looks darker.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

stem: Jaya measures two cups of tea. Cup P reads 48 °C. Cup Q reads 61 °C. Cup P looks darker.

part_answers.answer: The hotter body has the higher temperature reading, so Cup Q at 61 °C is hotter.

teacher.key_rationale: Temperature readings compare how hot the cups are. The higher reading is hotter. Colour of the tea is not the temperature.
